aiNoStream: 浏览器不支持流式响应
This browser cannot read a streamed response
aiStopped: 已停止，内容可能不完整，可以接着写
Stopped; the answer may be incomplete. You can continue it
aiDisconnected: 连接断了，内容可能不完整，可以接着写
Connection lost; the answer may be incomplete. You can continue it
aiDisconnectedEmpty: 连接断了，没收到内容，可以重试
Connection lost before any text arrived. You can retry
aiContinuePrompt: 请接着上文继续写：从断处接着写，不要重复已写内容，也不要重新开头。
Continue from where you stopped; do not repeat or restart the answer.
aiChatNotSaved: 已开新对话。本机存不下了，刚才那条只留到关掉 DSH 为止；先删几条历史对话就能存
New chat started. This device has no room left, so the previous conversation is kept only until DSH is closed; delete some past conversations to make room
reportRestored: 重新生成没有写出内容，已保留原报告
Regeneration produced nothing; the previous report was kept
storeInterrupted: 写到一半被打断了，已写的部分保留着，可以接着写
Interrupted before it finished; what was written is kept and you can continue it
stepEdgeBack: 再往前就到出生以前了
Going further back would be before birth
stepEdgeForward: 再往后超出了这张盘能排的范围
Going further forward is beyond what this chart covers
handoffNoNav: 会话已创建，但界面没能自动跳过去。请在左侧会话列表里打开新会话继续。
The session was created, but the view could not switch to it. Open it from the session list on the left.
